import pandas as pd

def main():
    # Define source file paths
    source0_path = "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length1_32/test_0.csv"
    source1_path = "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length1_32/test_1.csv"
    target_path = "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length1_32/target_multisource_cot.csv"

    # Load Source 0: School info
    # Schema: ['School ID', 'school_name', 'type', 'size', 'budget']
    df_school = pd.read_csv(source0_path, dtype={
        'School ID': int,
        'school_name': str,
        'type': str,
        'size': int,
        'budget': int
    })

    # Load Source 1: Student info with scores
    # Schema: ['Student ID', 'student_name', 'gender', 'grade', 'school_name', 'reading_score', 'math_score']
    df_student = pd.read_csv(source1_path, dtype={
        'Student ID': int,
        'student_name': str,
        'gender': str,
        'grade': str,
        'school_name': str,
        'reading_score': int,
        'math_score': int
    })

    # Join student data with school data on school_name to get school attributes including School ID
    # The target schema requires 'School ID' from Source 0, so join on school_name (common column)
    df_merged = pd.merge(
        df_student,
        df_school,
        how='left',
        on='school_name',
        validate='many_to_one'  # each student belongs to one school
    )

    # Reorder and rename columns to match target schema:
    # Target Schema: ['Student ID', 'student_name', 'gender', 'grade', 'school_name',
    #                 'reading_score', 'math_score', 'School ID', 'type', 'size', 'budget']

    # Ensure all columns exist and are in correct types
    df_merged = df_merged[[
        'Student ID',
        'student_name',
        'gender',
        'grade',
        'school_name',
        'reading_score',
        'math_score',
        'School ID',
        'type',
        'size',
        'budget'
    ]]

    # Enforce data types explicitly (some may already be correct)
    df_merged = df_merged.astype({
        'Student ID': int,
        'student_name': str,
        'gender': str,
        'grade': str,
        'school_name': str,
        'reading_score': int,
        'math_score': int,
        'School ID': int,
        'type': str,
        'size': int,
        'budget': int
    })

    # Write the result to the target CSV file without the index
    df_merged.to_csv(target_path, index=False)

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
